meaning: Accessibility induction proves graph controls and map transfer; Mathlib fixed points identify inductive closure and coinductive closure under well-foundedness. Imported finite-history, typed-motion and finite-grounding results prove the first three adapters; rank mapping, strict parthood and all-premise warrant induction prove the other three. Explicit successor, singleton-cycle and reversed-order controls discriminate the semantics. The scoped self-application theorem is reused. All philosophical conditions are quantified inside the advertised conditional laws; no actual domain is assumed well-founded.
